import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import App from '@src/response-apps/guildSecretRealmWar/claim/app';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';
export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  if (!/^[!！/#＃]?灵脉攻防战领取奖励\s*$/.test((e.MessageText || '').trim())) {
    return;
  }
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const result = await App({ bid, uid: Number(e.uid), request: createBackendRequestContext(e) });
  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  if (result.code !== 'OK') {
    md.addText(result.data.message);
  } else {
    md.addText(`领取成功：灵晶${result.data.spiritCrystal} ｜ 贡献${result.data.contribution} ｜ 宗门声望${result.data.reputation}`);
  }
  void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate: e.isPrivate ?? false, bid, title: '灵脉攻防战', content: md, footer: [{ label: '返回', command: '/灵脉攻防战' }] }));
});
